newsitem.title: GERMANY: WestLB won't comment on Preussag/Hapag speculation.
newsitem.headline: WestLB won't comment on Preussag/Hapag speculation.

text.p: Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale on Monday declined to comment on industry speculation that it was behind a possible takeover by Preussag AG of travel and transport group Hapag Lloyd.
"We don't comment on speculation," a WestLB spokesman said in response to a Reuter enquiry.

Earlier, the managing director of holiday airline Condor Flugdienst GmbH said there was industry speculation that WestLB, which holds a 30 percent stake in Preussag and similar stakes in holiday airline LTU and tour operator TUI, wanted to combine its existing tourism holdings with those of Hapag-Lloyd.
Preussag last week declined to comment on a media report that it was in talks to take over Hapag-Lloyd but added that it did want to expand further, particularly in its transport division.
